description: Peer-to-peer AI inference payment channels on Solana devnet (Anchor 1.2). Upgrade authority initialises a config and settle mint; anyone can register a provider; open_channel escrows settle tokens into a channel vault. redeem/top_up/close were not exercised. Built with a single platform-tools version after cargo clean.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration on the Blockchains/orrery fork of orrery-node/orrery. The lab only changed declare_id to the Sol.College devnet program and built with `anchor build --arch v2` after a cargo clean. The hosted IDL is a hand-derived subset confirmed by the verifying transactions. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; fixes are offered upstream as ordinary pull requests and acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness on the Solana runtime (initialize, register_provider, open_channel)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/orrery/
QA: devnet proof of initialize, register_provider, open_channel, BadParams, and BadEndpoint
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Exercise redeem with an Ed25519-signed voucher and a channel close on the lab config
